purpose: Select epistemic depth from current risk/evidence signals without constraining reasoning to a fixed questionnaire.
principles: Triggers decide when deeper deliberation is required; current evidence generates the actual questions and methods.
Move micro -> macro -> micro: reproduce the concrete symptom, challenge goal/assumption/topology when warranted, then return to the smallest correct change and concrete verification.
Do not default to multi-agent debate, architecture search or self-reflection rituals.
Same-model critique is candidate-generation evidence, not independent verification.
When a knowledge/method/architecture gap exists, actively search external evidence and compare properties, fit, costs, failure modes and rejected alternatives.
Material proposals should be challenged by counterexamples; high-risk or disputed outcomes require genuinely independent evidence when available.

Stop deliberating when evidence is sufficient for the risk level, contradictions are resolved or explicitly bounded, and the plan demonstrably advances the governing done-condition without unnecessary complexity.
anti_bloat: Extend existing Control Kernel/Context/Assurance/Evolution before adding a subsystem.
Every new mechanism must state overlap, replacement/retirement, or why extension is impossible.
Do not turn guidance principles into accumulating guarantee prose when an invariant can be encoded as a contract/test/fitness property.
